column1: # Bottom layer for tests/cxraw.cx and tests/cxlibc.cx (the libc/POSIX call counts): path
# prefixes (ending in /) or exact paths listed here are not counted.  tests/cxinclude.cx
# (#include) reads tests/cxinclude-boundary.tsv instead, not this file.
# The product layer is a directory boundary: cx/sys/ cx/mem/ cx/text/ are L0; every other
# product file (src/, cx/) reaches libc only through them.  Tool and test scripts (tools/,
# tests/) run on this host only, are not product cx modules, and may print with printf/fprintf,
# so they are not counted here.  (cx upper modules that live under tools/ -- e.g. cxcc.cx --
# will declare their host docking explicitly once plans/cx-dock-pragma.md lands; this file is
# host bootstrap: the two files that start a product build before any module exists.
# header-surface probes: they exist to exercise a carried header, so migrating them to sys.*
# would delete the test (reasons in tests/cxinclude-boundary.tsv).
